sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (openpyxl read_only, in memory): Quality Checks row 33 'Each criterion states ONE full-credit bar - it doesn't enumerate several things then waive most, leaving the judge two targets. Reports every instance.'; Internal Quality Checks row 33 annotation (Mukesh: multiple verifiers combined in one flow is acceptable)
.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r8/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (incl. known false positive: one criterion covering a whole flow, checks 26/28/33)
.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r8/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (template criterion form: numbered legs, 'Pass only if all legs hold')
.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r8/task/instruction.md and environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md sections 2 and 5 (public requirements for card details and scroll preservation)
evidence: Read every criterion in all five dimensions. Each binary criterion ends with an explicit Fails list plus the catch-all 'Fails if any condition stated above does not hold', so the full-credit bar is the conjunction of every stated leg; no criterion lists several requirements and then waives most. Visual likert rows each give one 5..1 anchor ladder. Instances of qualifying/alternative/waiver language examined, each judged a single bar: (1) functional/judge.toml:29 hro_job_open 'team, manager and places are shown wherever the app shows job details or are evidenced by behaviour' - conditional display, not a waiver of creation/refusal legs; (2) :38 hro_add_candidate 'email wherever the app shows card details' and trailing 'The entered source is shown wherever the app shows card details' - conditional on app's own display; name/order/sharing remain mandatory (minor: source sentence placed after the Fails sentence, still covered by catch-all); (3) :56, :92, :164 'hiding it is optional' - the bar is server refusal with card unchanged, UI-or-replay is the route, not a second target; (4) :137 hro_refused_put_back 'A UI that refuses before the card moves, with the reason shown and focus on that card, also passes' - equivalent route satisfying the same three conditions; (5) :173, :254 'Whether ... controls/undo control is hidden is the app's choice' - not graded leg, consistent with prompt.md:23; (6) :263 hro_activity 'one line naming every card of a multi-card move ... also satisfies' - equivalent representation; 'The Observer can read the same lines' after Fails list is covered by catch-all; (7) scope-exclusion sentences (:65, :110, :236, :371, :380, :398, polish :87, :105) assign observables to sibling rows rather than waiving within the row; (8) gates/render/judge.toml:266 'a refusal message is welcome but not required' - one clearly excluded item, bar remains 'stays signed out'; (9) polish/judge.toml:114 hro_pol_session_resume 'unless the sign-in prompt has already appeared on its own (that also passes)' - equivalent outcome; (10) polish/judge.toml:78 hro_pol_live_board 'if neither scrolls at this viewport, add cards until one does, or record that no scroll exists and judge the other legs' - the only conditional waiver of an enumerated leg (scroll preservation, required by hireops_rules.md section 5 'how far they have scrolled'). It waives one of five legs, only when no scroll exists, so it is not 'enumerate several then waive most'; recorded as a P3 observation because the 'or' gives the judge a choice between adding cards and recording no scroll. Consistent with SKILL known false positive (flow bundling is not a check-33 defect). No runtime evidence is needed for this text-consistency row; raw-evidence-index.json current sha256 c16d7f9c...827a was noted but not relied on.
counterexample: Not a demonstrated defect. Hypothetical edge: an app whose board container scrolls only once many cards exist and resets scrollTop on every live update; with the polish setup's three cards and a non-scrolling page, a judge choosing 'record that no scroll exists' could pass hro_pol_live_board while a judge that adds cards fails it. Conforming alternative: a layout that never scrolls is correctly handled by the waiver.
suggested_fix: Optional tightening of hro_pol_live_board: 'if neither scrolls, add cards until one does; only if adding cards still produces no scroll, record that and judge the other legs.'
